text: B-11:7's stated REASON for calling the blue bar HP is broken by a frame, though its observation is not. B-11:7 argues the thick blue bar 'is HP — stayed pinned at 47/47 the whole segment, i.e. player took no damage'. reference/frames/session11/crit-focus/t1082.100.png shows a blue bar with the SAME maximum, 47, reading 31/47 - so the max-47 blue bar demonstrably depletes. B-11's within-segment observation survives (blue may well have been pinned across 25:01-27:00); the inference from it does not. Pushing the other way in the same direction: reference/frames/duel_dense/Nr4fQstqHDM_428.0.png reads green 20/20 and blue 26/26, and REBUILD_READINESS.md:178 - Kheshav's own-eyes A5 verdict on that exact frame range - records 'player HP **20/20**'. In that frame the ONLY bar reading 20/20 is the green one, so his HP read lands on GREEN. STANDING INVARIANT, said out loud: B-11 is a measurement doc and Nr4fQstqHDM_428.0 is a frame, and THE FRAME WINS. Filed PARTIAL, not HELD, because this is still a two-artifact join (A5 log line + A1 frame) rather than one artifact naming both a colour and a stat, and because it depends on Kheshav not having transcribed the wrong row. It does not close 'which bar is which'; it does say which side of the contradiction is currently carrying weight.

lane_impact: L8 ui-hud: do not lay out a fourth row for the stance-lock banner. It is the same 260x16-ish slot as the reload bar, swapped by one visibility flag. Getting this wrong shifts every element below it (the '150% DAMAGE' buff line sits directly under this row in all three frames).
text: The player HUD's THIRD row is a single slot that shows EITHER the reload/crit bar OR the 'CANNOT CHANGE STANCE' banner, never both. Measured at native 1920x1080 on three frames: the row occupies y~1031-1046, x~250-510 in ALL of them. In t1082.100.png that slot is a bar - white fill (~#EBEBEB) from x~250 to x~315 on the same brown empty track (~#311F00) the green and blue bars use - and there is NO 'CANNOT CHANGE STANCE' text anywhere. In t1003.000.png and Nr4fQstqHDM_428.0.png the identical slot is solid brown track with pale glyphs spelling 'CANNOT CHANGE STANCE', and there is no bar fill. This is the visual half of a mechanic the code already states: §1t113s0§.as:334 guards the whole three-state block on `this.§1t5182s0§.visible`, and BattleUI.as:262 reads `this.crittext.visible = percentage >= 1 && this.reloadbar.visible;` - the widget has an explicit visibility flag, and the frames show what fills the gap when it is off.

text: The three player-HUD bar fills and their shared empty track are MEASURED, not inferred, from one 1080p frame at native resolution. Sampling t1082.100.png at x=255..275 straight down: bar 1 core y=983 = RGB(0,154,5) ~ #009A05 green; bar 2 core y=1010 = RGB(51,78,227) ~ #334EE3 blue; bar 3 core y=1038 = RGB(236,236,236) ~ #ECECEC near-white. All three ride the SAME empty track, sampled to the right of each fill at y=983/1010/1038, x=440..500: RGB(~49,31,0) ~ #311F00 dark brown. CAVEAT stated up front: this is a lossy 1080p re-encode of an 800x480 native game (REBUILD_READINESS.md:171), so these are within-a-few-units approximations of the OG hues, not the SWF's authored fill values - the SWF shapes under reference/extracted/shapes/ are 1,822 unnamed numbered SVGs with no SymbolClass map, so the authored value is not currently recoverable. Explicitly does NOT bind colour to STAT: it binds colour to POSITION (1st/2nd/3rd track).
